blocks.text: The pages that should have carried the rest of the record fell everywhere — so the whole world is a hunting ground. Zones are built from **biomes**, each with its own look, ground, and the monster families that settled there.

items: **Corrupted** — where the blankness runs deepest; the most twisted pages gather here.

blocks.text: Each biome carries a **themed set of monsters**, drawn by level, so a zone's danger and its inhabitants match its biome automatically.
The fields are not flat. Their ground rises and falls in **broad levels joined by slopes**, so there is always higher ground to climb and lower ground to look down on.

Some roads run through a **pass between rock cliffs**. You cannot climb a cliff face — but here and there a cliff runs out and its high ground **slopes down to meet the road**, and there you can walk up onto the top.
Monsters walk exactly the ground you walk: any slope you can climb, they can climb after you, and a cliff that stops you stops them too.

text: *Status: the biome framework is in place. The specific map list, layouts, and named zones are still being built.*
